Interface VirtualViewRmi

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiClient
public interface VirtualViewRmi extends Remote
Remote callback interface exposed by an RMI client to the server. The server holds one such stub per connected client and uses it to push updates and errors back, and to check that the client is alive.
